compendia.name: Characters
compendia.description: The people at the heart of The Cartographer of Rain.

records.name: Mira Vey
records.context:
[age]24[/age]
[appearance]Wiry, dark curls cropped at the jaw, amber raincoat patched at both elbows.[/appearance]
[role]Apprentice cartographer who maps storms by listening to rain strike tuned glass.[/role]
[personality]Observant, stubbornly kind, uneasy with authority, prone to describing emotions as weather.[/personality]
[goal]Prove that the unnatural Glass Tide is being directed toward Lumenport.[/goal]
[fear]Repeating the mistake that cost her mentor his hearing.[/fear]
[speech]Precise when nervous; dry humor when she trusts someone.[/speech]
[equipment]Brass listening fork, waterproof field journal, blue chalk.[/equipment]

records.name: Orin Vale
records.context:
[age]61[/age]
[appearance]Broad-shouldered, silver beard, spectacles connected by a red cord.[/appearance]
[role]Keeper of the Archive of Tides and Mira's former teacher.[/role]
[personality]Patient, theatrical, protective of dangerous knowledge.[/personality]
[secret]He removed one page from the Rain Atlas after discovering it could influence storms, not merely predict them.[/secret]
[speech]Fond of nautical proverbs that he often invents on the spot.[/speech]

records.name: Captain Ilyra Seln
records.context:
[age]39[/age]
[appearance]Tall, close-shaved hair, green harbor uniform with a copper whistle.[/appearance]
[role]Captain responsible for Lumenport's sea walls and evacuation routes.[/role]
[personality]Decisive, skeptical of folklore, fiercely loyal to dockworkers.[/personality]
[goal]Keep the harbor open long enough for the outer islands to evacuate.[/goal]
[attitude toward Mira]Skeptical of Mira's warning and unwilling to disrupt the harbor without evidence.[/attitude toward Mira]
[speech]Short sentences and direct questions; never raises her voice.[/speech]
